name: crt-github-profile
description: Config-driven CRT-style GitHub profile SVG generator

scripts.generate:terminal: npm run inject:ascii && node scripts/prepare-terminal-config.mjs --out .tmp/terminal.generated.yml && svg-terminal generate --config .tmp/terminal.generated.yml --output assets/terminal.svg
scripts.generate:terminal:static: npm run inject:ascii && node scripts/prepare-terminal-config.mjs --out .tmp/terminal.generated.yml && svg-terminal generate --config .tmp/terminal.generated.yml --output assets/terminal-static.svg --static
scripts.compose:split: node scripts/compose-split-terminal.mjs assets/terminal.svg && node scripts/compose-split-terminal.mjs assets/terminal-static.svg --static
scripts.compose:unified: node scripts/compose-unified-profile.mjs assets/terminal-enhanced.svg && node scripts/compose-unified-profile.mjs assets/terminal-static-enhanced.svg
scripts.build:crt: npm run generate:terminal && npm run generate:terminal:static && npm run compose:split && npm run postprocess:anim && npm run postprocess:static && npm run compose:unified
scripts.build:profile: npm run generate:ascii && npm run generate:projects && npm run generate:contribution
scripts.build:all: npm run build:crt && npm run build:profile && npm run generate:readme
